title: Home Assistant API
description: Instructions on how to set up the RESTful API within Home Assistant.
body:
The **Home Assistant API** integration exposes a RESTful API and allows one to interact with a Home Assistant instance that is running headless. This integration depends on the [HTTP integration](/integrations/http/).

```yaml
# Example configuration.yaml entry
api:
```

For details to use the API, please refer to the [REST API](/developers/rest_api/) in the "Developer" section.
